subject: Hymnology, Devotional Poetry & Scripture

subject: Allegorical Literature & World Classics Translated

Tangkhul Aesopwui Tuitam kala Khararchan
subject: Fables, Children Literature & Moral Instruction
notes: Classic translation of Aesop's Fables into Tangkhul Naga by TLS. Includes beloved timeless animal allegories adapted with native flora, fauna, and idioms of the Tangkhul hills.

title: Tagorewui Gitanjali kala Shai-laaring: Selected Translations in Tangkhul Naga
alternate_titles: Rabindranath Tagore's Gitanjali Translated in Tangkhul Naga
Gitanjali: Song Offerings in Tangkhul Poetry

alternate_titles: World Classic Short Stories in Tangkhul Naga

title: Shimreishang kala Maitonphi: The Classic Tangkhul Epic Novel of Love and Tragedy

title: Wungram Okthot: The Novel of Highland Heritage and Clan Trials
alternate_titles: Wungram: A Chronicle of Tangkhul Highland Life

title: Yarra: A Novel of Tangkhul Youth and Spring Awakening
alternate_titles: Yarra: The Springtime of Naga Youth

title: Major Bob Khathing: The Great Tangkhul Patriot, Soldier, and Statesman of Tawang
alternate_titles: Ralengnao Bob Khathing: The Legendary Hero of Tawang and NEFA
Biography of Major Ralengnao 'Bob' Khathing, MC, Padma Shri
publisher: Tangkhul Scholars Association / NEFA Heritage Trust

Chronicles his early life in Ukhrul, heroism in World War II, historic 1951 peaceful integration of Tawang, and service as Indian Ambassador to Burma.

title: Rev. William Pettigrew: Ukhrulwui Pao-phungnao (The Pioneer of Tangkhul Education)

title: Rishang Keishing: The Legendary Tangkhul Parliamentarian and Chief Minister
alternate_titles: Biography of Rishang Keishing: Doyen of Northeast Indian Politics

publisher: Tangkhul Scholars Association / Imphal Heritage Press

title: Rowland Suisa (R. Suisa): The Prophet of Naga Peace, Democracy, and Customary Rights
alternate_titles: R. Suisa: The Life and Vision of a Tangkhul Thinker

title: Luingam Luikham: Custodian of Tangkhul Oral Literature and Customary Law
